what: Run note for finishing PREREG-P2's timing rows. It is committed before the first FRESH-07R trial. PREREG-P2.json (f8859411b) is unchanged and remains the pre-registration. This note changes no row, n, arm, gate or prediction. It records the source-freshness result, the resumption, the binaries, the covariate and the run-time lock rules.

part1_source_freshness.rule: If anything under platform-linux, cua-driver-core, jev-use, the contract or the sdk changed in 9a2b1d99e..a9baa8d10 or 9a2b1d99e..<live main>, stop the timing parts and report AFFECTED.

The classifier returns AFFECTED on the known range 0f1955d2f..9a2b1d99e (control).

(b) R2-10R native nm1, nm2, nd1 on R'' (orig/r2-10r/harness/native-plan.json, 174 trials; nm1+nm2 give 24 per arm per task, at least the 20 pairs per native task required).
(c) N-04 k1-r00..r23, k5-r00..r11, s0-r00..r23 on R''n (EXCLUSIVE), then vctl, dec1, dec2 on R''n (non-timing controls; SHARED as PREREG-P2 non_timing_rows and the N-04 plan's lock field).
(d) Lowest priority, only after (a)-(c): N-03 under a PREREG-P3 addendum committed before its first trial.

covariate.why: On the 9a2b1d99e line the idle overlay is unmapped and is mapped by the first cursor reveal, and the focus guard counts it as a popup (kvnloo/cua#20 regression, FRESH-07 probe). Every native row on main therefore carries it. It is recorded, never used to exclude a trial, and never compared across binaries (FIX-20O measures the fix).
covariate.guard_text: Each native click's structured summary (already in the raw trial rows): grab_held when it contains 'popup menu is open' / 'keyboard grab', else none.
covariate.overlay_map_state: harness/overlay_watch.py, started by harness/with_overlay_watch.sh around each native chunk inside the private session. It is a passive SubstructureNotify listener on the private root: one JSON line per create/map/unmap/destroy of an override-redirect root child, CLOCK_MONOTONIC and wall ns, plus an initial snapshot. It never redirects or grabs and never talks to the Driver. Per trial: overlay mapped at T0, and overlay map/unmap events inside [w_begin, w_end]. Measurement-only; harness files unchanged.

timing_rules.exclusive: harness/fresh07_chunks.sh exclusive with FRESH07_LABEL=fresh07r. The chunk waits until the cargo-build lock is free and the 1-min loadavg is <= 4.0 (FRESH07_QUEUE_LOAD_MAX=4.0). It then runs bin/quiet-timed fresh07r-<chunk> flock -w 60 <cargo-build.lock> timeout -k 15 900 <hostless private session>. Inside, the original load rule applies: a round or block starts only at 1-min loadavg <= 4.0. At most one EXCLUSIVE waiter is queued at a time, because the master runs the stages sequentially.
timing_rules.wait_budget: FRESH07_WAIT_LEDGER records, per chunk, the seconds waited before the window and the seconds held. The lane stops with BLOCKED evidence after 8 h (28800 s) of cumulative waiting (FRESH07_WAIT_BUDGET_S=28800).
timing_rules.holder_snapshots: harness/holder_snapshot.sh every 15 min while the lane waits or runs: a read-only /proc scan writing pid, ppid, elapsed time and executable name (no command lines) to p2/locks/holders/. Holders are never signalled.
timing_rules.shared: Builds and non-timing rows (vctl, dec1, dec2, the optional a9baa8d10 tools/list corroboration and N-03 builds) take the SHARED quiet-lane lock only after no EXCLUSIVE waiter is queued (FRESH07_SHARED_YIELD=1 / /proc/locks); then they take the cargo lock if they build. No timing row runs under SHARED.
timing_rules.session: Everything runs under bin/hostless + cua-x11-session.sh. Native rows add CUA_SESSION_ATSPI=1 and CUA_SESSION_EXTRA_ENV containing CUA_SESSION_ATSPI=1, plus hostless-strict as in wave 7. Telemetry is off. No provider (cap 0).

deviations_from_wave7_runner: fresh07_chunks.sh gains FRESH07_LABEL, FRESH07_QUEUE_LOAD_MAX, FRESH07_WAIT_LEDGER, FRESH07_WAIT_BUDGET_S and FRESH07_SHARED_YIELD. With all of them unset it behaves as in wave 7. The in-session harnesses, plans and analyzers are unchanged (orig/ 90/90 blob-identical).
Native chunks are wrapped in harness/with_overlay_watch.sh (covariate only).
